bounds.full_wait_bucket: 2 represents at least31 actual seconds since this process wait began
bounds.local_threads: one authority-lock owner; concurrent admission attempts are explicit transitions
bounds.audit_and_retirement_evidence: exact positive, wrong identity, or absent; pagination abstracted to bounded success/failure
bounds.policy_threads: one serialized SQLite writer; both enable/disconnect orders explored
bounds.external_history: zero versus at least one historical claim; no unbounded allocation count
bounds.observation_snapshot: exact live Node identity plus nonaccepting/no-current-consent, or missing
bounds.retirement_evidence: same-org exact immutable UID/generation positive, DELETE acknowledgement, wrong proof or absence

assumptions: Trusted operator controls the host before ready; arbitrary malicious root/database editing is outside the model.
Verified HTTPS authenticates the existing platform. A successful exact Node DELETE transaction irreversibly revokes all bound node credentials and enrolled membership.
APIKey names cannot be reused, and exact self-key DELETE permanently revokes that credential. The documented authentication-cache bound is30seconds.
SQLite stage commits are atomic and durable. A lost remote acknowledgement is distinct from a completed transaction.
Systemd inactive/control-group and GPU cleanup observations are abstract truthful predicates; actual kernel/device evidence requires independent qualification.
One held whole-host lease and the shared host lock are preconditions. No new native-to-lending/reimage cycle is modeled.
No wall-clock or finite completion guarantee: network, cleanup, revocation or the operator may never progress.
A positive NodeRetirement response is a same-org exact immutable UID proof from one repeatable-read snapshot, with retained tombstone/generation and no current membership or leases.
Normal gateway issuance and revocation share a node lock. Delayed mint after retirement cannot revive an old identity; new enrollment has a different immutable UID.
An exact same-org APIKey delete AuditEvent is immutable and commits atomically with revocation. Missing, expired or wrong events never prove deletion.

All four temporary-key slots are explored, matching the implementation admission bound. Credential bytes, audit pagination details and the unbounded remote database are abstracted, not exhaustively modeled.

A recovery credential file/name fingerprint is durably recorded before the first authenticated read; UID/org discovery completes that obligation. Operator secrets outside this managed protocol remain outside scope.
No fairness or completion claim: unavailable proof, exhausted bounded scan/key capacity, or network failure may leave the host quarantined forever.
The model origin is an oracle for genuine continuously tracked first connection versus legacy/history-bearing state; implementation must prove that classification from durable records.
Schema3/history/policy writes inside a SQLite transaction commit atomically; crash does not split a committed transaction. The omission mutants intentionally violate this contract.

The whole-host lease and dedicated-key validity preconditions of the existing native model are retained. Historical external claims are summarized after completion, not simultaneous with that exclusive lease.
Observation connection status does not itself grant allocation authority. A policy enable is an explicit accepted-consent operation, never an effect of metric observation.

The new no-consent route requires affirmative exact NodeRetirement even after an acknowledged normal DELETE. This proof is an authenticated abstract input, not a model verification of the platform endpoint.
No equivalence/refinement proof connects this model to Python, SQLite, remote services or hardware. Model safety is separate from current implementation conformance.
fairness: None. This run checks safety over all reachable bounded states; no liveness or wall-clock guarantee is claimed.
proof_scope: Only this finite abstract model. Implementation, GPU and processor conformance remain unverified.
